reports.title: Molson Coors Beverage Company Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results ______________________________________________________________

guidance.heading: 2026 OUTLOOK
section: We have adjusted our 2026 guidance for certain key financial metrics due to the impacts of the global macroeconomic environment on the beer industry and on consumer behavior along with persistent promotional activity in the U.K. While we have included in our guidance our best estimate of some of these factors, including higher than anticipated logistics costs, the impacts of these trends are difficult to predict and include inherent uncertainties that could impact our financial performance beyond what is contemplated in our guidance.
•Net sales: decline 1% to 2% on a constant currency basis compared to flat, plus or minus 1%, previously
•Underlying income (loss) before income taxes: decline 21% to 24% versus 2025 on a constant currency basis compared to a decline in the range of 15% to 18%, previously
•Underlying earnings per share: decline 16% to 19% versus 2025, compared to a decline in the range of 11% to 15%, previously
•Capital expenditures: $650 million incurred, plus or minus 5%
•Underlying free cash flow: $1.0 billion, plus or minus 10% compared to $1.1 billion, plus or minus 10%, previously
•Underlying depreciation and amortization: $720 million, plus or minus 5%
•Consolidated net interest expense: $260 million, plus or minus 5%
•Underlying effective tax rate: in the range of 22% to 24%
